pages.text: In class, Teacher Sam starts a gratitude wall.
Each child writes one thankful note on a paper leaf.
Lina writes, Thank you to Dad for reading with me.
Omar writes, Thank you to my friend for sharing crayons.
The wall fills with kind notes and bright drawings.
After lunch, children help clean tables without being asked.
They deliver a thank you card to the school cook.
The cook smiles and says their kindness made her day better.
Lina notices she feels warm and happy when she gives thanks.
The class learns small gratitude actions can spread kindness everywhere.
